When morning came, the bottle was gone, and a fresh sheet of paper waited beside his pen.","w02":"凌晨四点，城市像一封尚未拆开的信。路灯把薄雾照成淡金色，清洁工推着车，扫过昨夜遗落的喧哗。早餐铺亮起第一盏灯，蒸汽贴着玻璃缓缓上升。远处，一辆末班货车驶过空荡的桥，声音很快被河水收走。有人刚刚入睡，有人已经出门，而天边那道浅蓝，正悄悄替每一扇窗准备清晨。","w03":"- Recursion is when a set of instructions uses itself to solve a smaller version of the same problem.\n- Imagine opening a box, finding a smaller box inside, and repeating until you find a toy.\n- Every recursive process needs a stopping rule, like stopping when there are no more boxes."}
